notes: Robustness gate for the successful non-private LearnedKParameter method from 9A. Fresh training/test fleets are separate. Discrete regimes pass if learned tracking is within 5% of oracle-family, test ARI is at least 0.9, all runs are feasible/stable, and fewer models than Local are used. The continuous regime interpolates physical parameters between handling and heavy endpoints with small scatter and has no family labels. It passes if learned tracking is within 5% of a partition selected from true ratios, improves Global by at least 20%, is feasible/stable, and uses fewer models than Local. Privacy and the failed 9A control-weighted geometry are excluded.
